import sys

# Retrieve cached flight search results for outbound and return legs
outbound_cache_key = "departure_flights"
return_cache_key = "return_flights"

outbound_results = get_results_from_cache(key=outbound_cache_key)
return_results = get_results_from_cache(key=return_cache_key)

# Validate that cache results exist and contain required data
if outbound_results is None or return_results is None:
    # If cache is missing, perform new searches for both legs
    outbound_search = search_flights(
        start_airport_city="Las Vegas",
        end_airport_city="Colorado Springs",
        departure_date=["May 21, 2025"],
        flight_class=["business", "first"],
        budget=1100,
        num_layovers=[1],
        layover_1_duration_minutes=60
    )
    save_to_cache(key=outbound_cache_key, value=outbound_search)
    outbound_results = outbound_search

    return_search = search_flights(
        start_airport_city="Colorado Springs",
        end_airport_city="Las Vegas",
        departure_date=["May 31, 2025"],
        flight_class=["business", "first"],
        budget=1100,
        num_layovers=[1],
        layover_1_duration_minutes=60
    )
    save_to_cache(key=return_cache_key, value=return_search)
    return_results = return_search

# Filter outbound flights to match budget constraint
filtered_outbound = filter_flights(
    prior_results=outbound_results,
    budget=1100
)

# Filter return flights to match budget constraint
filtered_return = filter_flights(
    prior_results=return_results,
    budget=1100
)

# Save filtered results to cache for future use
save_to_cache(key="filtered_outbound_flights", value=filtered_outbound)
save_to_cache(key="filtered_return_flights", value=filtered_return)

# Generate summary response to user
query_summary = (
    f"Found {len(filtered_outbound.search_results)} outbound flights and {len(filtered_return.search_results)} return flights "
    f"under ${1100} with business or first class, 1 layover max, and 60-minute max layover duration."
)

print(query_summary)
